proposition.claim:
Kind: paraphrase

Locator: Corollary4.3 PDF16–17 (2780–2781); model4.5 and Cor3.1 PDF10

Text: Under the stated prior conditions, the minimal necessary observation growth is n/sigma^4 ->infinity regardless of algorithm.

G=SO(2) acts onV=R2 directsumR2 by(z,w)->(z,Rtheta w); Haar rotations and iid N(0,sigma^2 I) noise. Irreducible block sizes (1,2),(2,1), so k1,D4,K3. Known generic affine line p+t u, M1, det(p0,u0)!=0, K>2M.

Kind: paraphrase

Locator: Section6.1 PDF18; Section6.2 PDF21; orthogonal/complex proof PDF22–25

Text: Parallel equal-norm pairs are equivalent in the relation Gamma(x,y)=Gamma, allowing direct application of the stated fiber condition.

V=R2,H={I,diag(-1,1)},Gamma=GL2. x=e1,y=-e1,K2.

Kind: paraphrase

Locator: Definition framework PDF5; incidence6.1 PDF18–19

Text: Each fixed automorphism being semi-algebraic suffices to make the joint incidence semi-algebraic.

Gamma=(R,+),theta.(u,v)=(exp(theta)u,v). H={identity,coordinate swap}. M={e1} union{(0,t):t>0}.

Kind: paraphrase

Locator: AfterEq3.4 PDF10

Text: Orbits of product orthogonal ambiguity group are connected iff all irreducible dimensions exceed1.

One N byR block, N=R=2. X=I2.

Kind: paraphrase

Locator: Theorem4.1 PDF14; Eq4.4 PDF15

Text: Leading approximation usesL^2(R+2L/3) and ratio display subtracts an extra(L+1) factor.

R>=2L+1. D=R(L+1)^2. k=sum_l binom(2l+1,2)=L(L+1)(4L+5)/6.

Kind: paraphrase

Locator: PDF8, The tightness of bounds in Theorem2.2

Text: Coefficients(1,2,2,4) illustrate a GL2-translated parabola.

Equationa x+b y-(c x+d y)^2=0. Claim requiresad-bc!=0.

repair.content:
State second-moment sufficiency, or impose and establish first-moment nonidentifiability plus required statistical lower-bound assumptions.

Use bad incidence y!=+/-x for real GL/O and exclude unit-phase multiples for complex GL/U; repeat lemma proof with that invariant relation; retain equality for affine case.

Require joint action map Gamma timesV ->V to be semi-algebraic.

For all orbits in each nonzero block requireR<N; for a specified matrix require rank<N.

UseK=R(L+1)^2-L(L+1)(4L+5)/6 throughout; minus sign inleading term andremove extraL+1 inratio.

Replace coefficients by a verified invertible example.

Systematically correct body numbers, referenceentries andlinks usingverifiedsource identities andlocators.
